# MakeHuman assets (CC0 1.0)

Subset of the MakeHuman 1.x system assets used by `tools/assetgen/human_gen.cpp` to build the rider
(`assets/models/rider.glb`):

| file | use |
|------|-----|
| `base.obj` | hm08 base mesh (body topology, UVs, joint helpers, eyelash helpers) |
| `targets/macrodetails/*.target` | shape targets: young male, ethnic mix, muscle / weight, height, proportions |
| `rigs/default.mhskel`, `rigs/default_weights.mhw` | reference skeleton + skin weights (re-posing and weight remapping) |
| `eyes/high-poly.obj`, `eyes/high-poly.mhclo`, `eyes/brown_eye.png` | eyeball proxy + texture |

Source: https://github.com/makehumancommunity/makehuman (commit a8bc2d54ff0ac92e78ff71431b1023eda42bf482),
`makehuman/data/...`. The MakeHuman project releases its bundled assets (base mesh, proxies, targets,
textures, skeletons, weights) under CC0 1.0 Universal - see `LICENSE.ASSETS.md`. Only asset data is
used; no MakeHuman program code (AGPL) is included or derived from.

Everything else about the rider (skin / hair / fabric texture baking, clothing, shoes, headwear, the
game skeleton, animation) is generated by this project's own code.
